title: Global operators
statement:
Use the coefficient and derived-category notation $A$, $D(Z,A)$ of [sk-d-setup]. Fix the pro-étale geometric operations over the base scheme $s$ of [sk-d-six], so that $f^*$ and $f^!$ already denote derived functors. Let $X$ be an $s$-scheme, let $K\in D(X,A)$, and let $(C,c_1,c_2,u)$ be an endocorrespondence of $(X,K)$ of [sk-d-corr]: $c_1,c_2:C\to X$ are $s$-morphisms, $c_1$ is compactifiable [def-nagata-compactifiable] with the given adjunction $Rc_{1!}\dashv c_1^!$, and $u:c_2^*K\to c_1^!K$. Assume that the ordinary leg $c_2$ is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Write $a_X:X\to s$, $a_C:C\to s$, with $a_Xc_1=a_C=a_Xc_2$, and $R\Gamma_c(Z,M)=Ra_{Z!}M$ as in [sk-d-six], using the functors and comparison data supplied there.

Let $\eta_2:\mathrm{id}\to Rc_{2*}c_2^*$ be the unit of $c_2^*\dashv Rc_{2*}$, let $\varepsilon_1:Rc_{1!}c_1^!\to\mathrm{id}$ be the exceptional counit, and let $P_2:Rc_{2!}\xrightarrow{\sim}Rc_{2*}$ be the proper comparison of [sk-d-six]. The composition comparisons of that package give
$$
\mu_i:Ra_{X!}Rc_{i!}\xrightarrow{\sim}R(a_Xc_i)_!=Ra_{C!}\quad(i=1,2).
$$
Define the global operator $T_c(u)\in\operatorname{End}(R\Gamma_c(X,K))$ as the following composite:
$$
\begin{aligned}
Ra_{X!}K&\xrightarrow{Ra_{X!}(\eta_{2,K})}
Ra_{X!}Rc_{2*}c_2^*K
\xrightarrow{Ra_{X!}(P_{2,c_2^*K}^{-1})}
Ra_{X!}Rc_{2!}c_2^*K
\xrightarrow{\mu_{2,c_2^*K}}
Ra_{C!}c_2^*K\\
&\xrightarrow{Ra_{C!}(u)}Ra_{C!}c_1^!K
\xrightarrow{\mu_{1,c_1^!K}^{-1}}Ra_{X!}Rc_{1!}c_1^!K
\xrightarrow{Ra_{X!}(\varepsilon_{1,K})}Ra_{X!}K.
\end{aligned}
$$
All maps are components of the specified adjunctions and comparison isomorphisms, or functor images of those maps and of $u$; this is a definition in the ambient derived category, without a bounded-constructibility or finite-Tor hypothesis on $K$.
